title: Seasons in short lines
intro: Three short lines for each season. Type at an easy pace.
lines: Spring: buds open on the branches.
Spring: birds begin to sing early.
Summer: long light in the evening.
Summer: the air feels warm and still.
Summer: fruit ripens on the vine.
Autumn: leaves drift down in gold and red.
Autumn: seeds scatter on the wind.
Winter: the days are short and crisp.
Winter: bare branches show the sky.
